items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: No. I never had Eric Dolphy. Never worked for me.

ctx.x: And Par Jones. I looked up some research I did for the Black California liner notes in which I talked to Ernie Freeman, and he mentioned that your band had Wilfred Middlebrooks on bass sometimes, and Eric Dolphy on tenor, is that right?
No. I never had Eric Dolphy. Never worked for me.
